# Completion Audit — Revision-Bound Audit Validity (steal #3)

## Verdict: APPROVED

## Assessment

**Round-1 findings are genuinely fixed, not just re-papered.** The prior disapproval (audit-mshwj71i) empirically proved two dead-ends: (1) v0.34.59 bumped the revision on *every* `persistState`, so the audit-settle write itself moved the goal one revision past the verdict's recorded revision — a second `complete_goal` with zero contract change was falsely rejected; (2) the documented escape (`/goal verify` → `complete_goal`) dead-ended the same way. Commit `3cfc310b` removes the bump from `persistState` (goal.ts:2911-2919) and adds it to exactly the two contract-change sites: `cmdTweak` (goal.ts:4439, covers `/goal tweak` and `/list tweak` of the active item) and the `complete_goal` newObjective handler (goal.ts:5928). `updateGoal` merges `{...state.goal, ...patch}`, so the bump survives the patch. The `stale_revision_refused` apply-time guard is now contract-scoped and only fires on a contract change mid-audit.

**Gate semantics are correct.** goal.ts:5945-5962 rejects when `lastAudited.revision` (a number) ≠ current revision and the call carries no `newObjective`, emitting the `complete_goal_revision_rejected` ledger entry (currentRevision, auditedRevision, auditedAt, objective) and a REJECTED text naming the mismatch — before any mutation (test asserts goal untouched). Legacy entries without a revision pass. `newObjective` claims skip the gate because their audit covers the new contract in the same call — consistent with "an old approval cannot be cited against a new contract" (no old approval is cited).

**The two round-1 failures are pinned by real-tool tests**, not mocks: the settle test drives two `complete_goal` calls with zero contract change and asserts `history.at(-1).revision === goal.revision` after settle; the escape test drives tweak → REJECTED → `/goal verify` (real verify route, fake auditor binary) → PROCEEDS.

**Minor non-blocking nit:** stale doc comments remain in `goal-loop-core.ts` (line 313-314 "bumped on every persistState" and `bumpGoalRevision`'s doc "strictly increases on every committed write") — comments only, no behavioral impact.

**Reject-class:** no test spawns a test runner (grep for `spawn|exec|bun test|npm test` → no matches).
